facts.fact: GBoS's NSDS III says the 2005 Statistics Act governs statistical activities in The Gambia, provides for the national statistical system and establishes GBoS as its supervisory authority; the strategy was published 2023-09.

NSDS III says the Statistics Act is under revision with stakeholder inputs, and plans to review the 2019 Statistics Bill, advocate for its enactment and adopt a new statistics law by 2026; strategy published 2023-09.
